usage: tunnel requests [-h] [--base BASE] [--json] [--each] [--key KEY]
                       [--host HOST] [--since SEQ] [--last N] [--unmatched]
                       [--encrypted] [-q TEXT]
                       {show} ...

positional arguments:
  {show}
    show              one request and its response in full

options:
  -h, --help          show this help message and exit
  --base BASE         where the admin API answers (default
                      http://127.0.0.1:8000)
  --json              print raw JSON, errors included, for piping into jq
  --each              one row per request instead of the aggregate
  --key KEY           only this rule key, e.g. GET:api.example.com/api/feed
  --host HOST         only this host; * is a wildcard
  --since SEQ         only what arrived after this seq
  --last N            only the last N entries
  --unmatched         only requests no rule answered
  --encrypted         only tunnels that were not decrypted
  -q, --keyword TEXT  keyword: matches host, path, query, status and rule
